# package filetransfer

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/filetransfer"
```

Package filetransfer is the client of the File Transfer of OPC 10000-20: a FileType Object (§4.2) read and written through a handle of its Open Method, with io.Reader and io.Writer adapters, and the directories of a FileDirectoryType Object (§4.3): CreateDirectory, CreateFile, Delete and MoveOrCopy.

The Methods are called with the contracts of package uamethod: the arguments are packed and the results checked against the declarations of namespace 0. A Method of the Object is found by its BrowseName below the Object; an Object without it is called with the declaration of the type, which Part 4 §5.12.2.2 (1.05.06) allows. A Bad result is a \*uamethod.CallError, so errors.Is(err, ua.StatusBadInvalidState) holds.

## Constants

```go
const DefaultChunk = 64 << 10
```

DefaultChunk is the length of one Read and the most bytes of one Write when Object.Chunk is zero. A server may return less than asked for (OPC 10000-20 §4.2.4).

Directory is a FileDirectoryType Object of a server (OPC 10000-20 §4.3.1): the root of a file system (the FileSystem Object, §4.3.2) or a directory below it.

#### func NewDirectory

```go

```

#### func (Directory) CreateDirectory

```go
func (d *Directory) CreateDirectory(ctx context.Context, name string) (*ua.NodeID, error)
```

CreateDirectory calls CreateDirectory (OPC 10000-20 §4.3.3) and returns the NodeId of the new directory. A name that exists is Bad\_BrowseNameDuplicated.

#### func (Directory) CreateFile

```go
func (d *Directory) CreateFile(ctx context.Context, name string, open bool) (*Object, *File, error)
```

CreateFile calls CreateFile (OPC 10000-20 §4.3.4) and returns the FileType Object of the new file. With open, the file is "opened with the Write and Read bits set", and the File of the handle is returned too.

#### func (Directory) Delete

```go
func (d *Directory) Delete(ctx context.Context, obj *ua.NodeID) error
```

Delete calls Delete (OPC 10000-20 §4.3.5) for a file or directory the directory Organizes; a directory is deleted with all below it.

#### func (Directory) Directory

```go
func (d *Directory) Directory(nodeID *ua.NodeID) *Directory
```

Directory returns the directory of a NodeId of an Entry.

#### func (Directory) Entries

```go
func (d *Directory) Entries(ctx context.Context) ([]Entry, error)
```

Entries returns the directories and files of the directory: the Objects it Organizes whose TypeDefinition is FileDirectoryType or FileType (OPC 10000-20 §4.3.1, Table 8). An Object of a subtype of either is recognized by the TypeDefinition of the type only, which this method does not follow.

#### func (Directory) File

```go
func (d *Directory) File(nodeID *ua.NodeID) *Object
```

File returns the FileType Object of a NodeId of an Entry.

#### func (Directory) MoveOrCopy

```go
func (d *Directory) MoveOrCopy(ctx context.Context, obj, target *ua.NodeID, createCopy bool, newName string) (*ua.NodeID, error)
```

MoveOrCopy calls MoveOrCopy (OPC 10000-20 §4.3.6) for a file or directory the directory Organizes: it is moved, or copied with createCopy, to the directory target with the name newName ("" keeps the name). A rename has the directory itself as target. It returns the NodeId of the moved or copied object, which may be a new one even for a move.

#### func (Directory) NodeID

```go
func (d *Directory) NodeID() *ua.NodeID
```

NodeID returns the NodeId of the directory.

### type File

```go
type File struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

File is an open handle of a FileType Object. A File is for one goroutine at a time, as the position of the handle is.

#### func (File) Close

```go
func (f *File) Close(ctx context.Context) error
```

Close calls Close (OPC 10000-20 §4.2.3); the handle is no longer valid. Closing a File again does nothing.

#### func (File) Handle

```go
func (f *File) Handle() uint32
```

Handle returns the fileHandle of Open.

#### func (File) Mode

```go
func (f *File) Mode() ua.OpenFileMode
```

Mode returns the mode the handle was opened with.

#### func (File) Position

```go
func (f *File) Position(ctx context.Context) (uint64, error)
```

Position calls GetPosition (OPC 10000-20 §4.2.6).

#### func (File) Read

```go
func (f *File) Read(ctx context.Context, length int32) ([]byte, error)
```

Read calls Read once (OPC 10000-20 §4.2.4) for up to length bytes from the position of the handle; length must be positive. An empty result is the end of the file, io.EOF.

#### func (File) ReadAllAndClose

```go
func (f *File) ReadAllAndClose(ctx context.Context, limit int) ([]byte, error)
```

ReadAllAndClose reads from the position of the handle to the end of the file and closes the handle, whatever the outcome. More than limit bytes (limit > 0) is an error.

#### func (File) Reader

```go
func (f *File) Reader(ctx context.Context) io.Reader
```

Reader returns an io.Reader of the file from the position of the handle: each Read of it is one Read call of up to len(p) bytes.

#### func (File) SetPosition

```go
func (f *File) SetPosition(ctx context.Context, pos uint64) error
```

SetPosition calls SetPosition (OPC 10000-20 §4.2.7): a position past the end of the file is the end.

#### func (File) Write

```go
func (f *File) Write(ctx context.Context, data []byte) error
```

Write calls Write (OPC 10000-20 §4.2.5) with data at the position of the handle, in chunks of Object.Chunk bytes.

#### func (File) Writer

```go
func (f *File) Writer(ctx context.Context) io.Writer
```

Writer returns an io.Writer of the file at the position of the handle.

#### func (Object) Open

```go

```

Open calls Open with mode (OPC 10000-20 §4.2.2) and returns the File of the handle. ua.OpenFileModeRead reads the file; ua.OpenFileModeWrite with ua.OpenFileModeEraseExisting replaces it.

#### func (Object) ReadAll

```go

```

ReadAll opens the file for reading, reads it to its end and closes it. More than limit bytes (limit > 0) is an error.

#### func (Object) WriteAll

```go
func (o *Object) WriteAll(ctx context.Context, data []byte) error
```

WriteAll replaces the content of the file with data: Open with Write and EraseExisting, Write and Close.
